title: Rehearsing and film scoring
summary: He likes rehearsing and film best.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: And you could rehearse say over a semester's period of time.
I enjoy rehearsing, I always enjoyed rehearsing anything. Performances don't get me that much, but rehearsing I like.

The most enjoyable thing is doing a film, if they give you enough time to do it, but even when they haven't, I've enjoyed it. Whether I could continue or what I would do if I ran into a situation where there really wasn't time and I had to farm it out, which would be becoming a contractor, that's something else; I wouldn't like that at all.
There you're basically a businessman more than anything else.
